what: Eval compute-budget gate: prices the e-0047 statistically-recommended headline design (within-deep n, interior-k pass@k, multi-size DiD) as a multiple of the one eval run e-0006/a-0005 proved fits the free tier (50 samples / 56 T4-min). EVAL only; training (e-0007) excluded; PRE-SFT lower bounds.
verdict: The statistically-recommended headline design is COMPUTE-EXPENSIVE relative to the only eval run the project has proven affordable. At the within-deep effective n=106 (2 policies), the full powered interaction (k=16, 3 sizes) = 204x the proven-affordable e-0006 run (190.0h T4 linear, 100.9h gen-batched), dominated by the irreducible n*k Lean verifications. The interior-k lever that e-0047 needs to make the interaction resolvable is the SAME lever that drives this cost. Affordable-side options: the k=4/2-size powered design = 34x (31.7h), and the single-size pass@1 gap (q-0007 only, NOT the interaction) = 8x (7.9h). All figures are PRE-SFT lower bounds (t1 from the degenerate model; SFT'd generation+verification is slower) and EXCLUDE QLoRA training (e-0007). Decision: stage the eval -- run the single-size pass@1 gap first (8x, resolves +0.11-0.16), and only escalate to the multi-size interior-k interaction once a single-size signal justifies the 68-204x spend.
